title: Sheet and Drawing Semantic Classification
purpose: Classify sheet and drawing meaning independently from the identifier syntax used by an authority, client, CDE, or project.
principles: Document identity is not the sole carrier of document meaning.

Project stage, work condition, spatial scope, discipline, information form, content class, content subtype, sequence, status/suitability, revision, and title are independent governed dimensions unless a higher authority explicitly combines them.
A lower-precedence profile may fill a missing definition but shall not silently override a higher-precedence requirement.
Project stage shall not be inferred from work condition, revision, status/suitability, or sheet title.
Work condition such as existing, demolition, proposed, future, or temporary shall not be treated as project stage.
Classification shall be resolved before first formal CDE registration where the document number becomes a governed project identity.

classification_rules.rule: Overall floor plans classify as plan unless a higher authority defines another class.
A partial floor plan created by splitting an overall plan for sheet size remains a plan unless a higher authority defines another class.
An enlarged room, unit, or local-area plan is distinct from a construction detail and shall be classified separately at subtype level even where a project maps both into the same numbering range.
Reflected ceiling plans remain plan content with a reflected_ceiling_plan subtype unless a governing profile explicitly assigns a separate class.
Door, window, finish, and equipment schedules classify as schedule content unless a governing profile explicitly assigns another class.
Perspectives and isometrics classify as three_dimensional_representation unless a governing profile explicitly assigns another class.
A project-specific numbering range does not redefine the semantic content class; the mapping is stored in the applicable numbering profile.

open_research: Confirm international and regional authority treatment for ambiguous drawing-content subtypes before promoting fallback numeric ranges.
Confirm Miral/UAE client-specific content classification and Aconex mappings from governing project evidence before creating a Miral profile.
